AbilityDef.label: recursion
AbilityDef.description:
Hold the membrane open. Everything moving toward the carrier begins halving the distance it has left and loses the ability to finish - rounds drift in and hang short, blades and fists miss by margins that keep doubling, and nothing that started toward them ever quite arrives.

Air is approaching too. The carrier stops breathing the moment this goes up and does not start again until it comes down. There is no cooldown worth speaking of, because the limit is a lung.

Nothing has been destroyed or turned aside. Everything still on its way lands the instant the membrane closes - including whatever has been queuing up against their face. Let go early.
